new_destinations.name: Huzhou
new_destinations.coordinates_source: Lianhuazhuang/Wuxing city point from candidates (Wuxing district centre); pin stage to confirm against OSM place=city
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a "Huzhou" city/prefecture page that lists the Huzhou Museum, Lianhuazhuang and Changxing sights (Chinese Alligator Village).
new_destinations.reason: 5 kept spots (Huzhou Museum, Lianhuazhuang Park, Brush Museum, Gu Zhu Mountain, Chinese Alligator Village), above the four-spot bar. Rank 4: a prefecture city that guidebooks cover but not a headline; Anji, Nanxun and Moganshan are separate named bases. Overlap checked against Anji, Nanxun, Hangzhou: centres >33 km apart.

new_destinations.name: Anji
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the Anji spots (county seat Dipu and Tianhuangping); pin stage to confirm
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has an "Anji" page covering the county: Bamboo Exposition Park, Great Bamboo Sea, Yunshang ski resort; Anji is a tourism brand ("China Bamboo Town").
new_destinations.reason: 8 kept spots, a county travellers name (bamboo sea, Tianhuangping). Rank 4: worth a detour from Hangzhou/Shanghai. Moganshan (Deqing, ~22 km E) is outside Anji and stays standalone.

placements.name: Huzhou Museum
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou lists it with hours and three permanent exhibitions; a city museum visitors can tour for an hour.
placements.skeptic_objection: A provincial-level comprehensive city museum is an ordinary stop; Chinese-only labels likely.
placements.bio_draft: museum: Huzhou city's national second-level comprehensive museum (collections, Huzhou history and art), Tue-Sun
placements.reason: Wuxing urban area, ~2 km from the Huzhou centre; inside the city metro.

placements.name: Lianhuazhuang Park
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou lists it (06:00-20:00), lotus pond and old trees on Zhao Mengfu's garden site; a half-hour stroll beside the Brush Museum.
placements.skeptic_objection: Largely a 1980s reconstruction; an urban park.
placements.bio_draft: park: old garden park with ancient evergreen trees, lotus pond and pavilion in Wuxing
placements.reason: Wuxing district, ~3 km from the centre; inside the city.

placements.name: Huzhou Brush Museum
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Zhejiang tourism (ct.zj.gov.cn China Hubi Museum) and China Daily Huzhou name it; Huzhou brush is one of the Four Treasures of the study and the museum has a Zhao Mengfu hall.
placements.skeptic_objection: Sources disagree on location (Lianhuazhuang vs Shanlian town) so the pin needs checking; niche craft museum.
placements.bio_draft: museum: museum of Huzhou brush-making (Huzhou pen, one of the Four Treasures of the study)
placements.reason: Shanlian town, Nanxun-Wuxing border, ~28 km from the centre: within the 52 km reach and part of Huzhou municipal area where the Huzhou brush trade is based. Sources disagree on location (Lianhuazhuang vs Shanlian); OSM way 121039006 is at Shanlian, pin stage to confirm.

placements.name: Gu Zhu Mountain
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: huzhou.gov.cn place-of-interest and China Daily describe the Tang Tribute Tea Academy museum on Gu Zhu Mountain, tied to Lu Yu's Classic of Tea.
placements.skeptic_objection: Pin should sit at the Tribute Tea Academy, not the mountain; visitor admission details unconfirmed.
placements.bio_draft: historic: mountain where the Tang imperial tribute tea (Guzhu purple bud) was made and where Lu Yu is said to have written the Classic of Tea; ruins of a tribute tea court
placements.reason: Changxing county, Huzhou prefecture, roughly 30 km NW of the centre (to be confirmed at pin stage); reached from Huzhou city. Pin at the Tang Tribute Tea Academy (the visitor site on the mountain), not the summit.
placements.pin_note: Pin at the Tribute Tea Academy (Tang Tribute Tea Academy museum) on Gu Zhu Mountain.

placements.name: Chinese Alligator Village
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou names it among Changxing's attractions; a breeding park with Chinese alligators.
placements.skeptic_objection: A captive-breeding attraction, one source.
placements.bio_draft: nature: alligator-breeding park with Chinese alligators in Changxing (a wildlife attraction)
placements.reason: Changxing town, ~20 km NW of the Huzhou centre; Changxing is a district-level part of Huzhou municipality and visitors reach it from Huzhou city.

placements.name: Great Bamboo Sea (Anji)
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji and Huzhou name it (Wuhe village, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon film location); an obvious draw with two counted sources.
placements.skeptic_objection: Remote by minibus and a bus transfer; the name is also used for other bamboo forests in the county.
placements.bio_draft: nature: bamboo forest scenic area of Wuhe village in Tianhuangping, the Anji "Great Bamboo Sea" used as a film location (Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon); name also used for Yixing's bamboo sea in Jiangsu
placements.reason: Tianhuangping, ~8 km S of the Anji centre point; headline draw.

placements.name: Anji Bamboo Exposition Park
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji names it as the county centrepiece with a bamboo museum and a panda house.
placements.skeptic_objection: Themed park with a family bias.
placements.bio_draft: park: bamboo-themed exposition park with the China Bamboo Museum, Panda House and a zoo area, a county centrepiece
placements.reason: Anji county seat area, ~4 km N of the Anji centre point.

placements.name: Jiangnan Tianchi
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji names the AAAA scenic area at Tianhuangping (also called Tianchi River), with a lake and planetarium; nearby Great Bamboo Sea draws.
placements.skeptic_objection: The listing reads as promotional copy; one source.
placements.bio_draft: nature: AAAA scenic area at the northern foot of Tianmu Mountain in Tianhuangping, with a planetarium and resort; OSM tags the scenic entrance
placements.reason: Tianhuangping, ~10 km S of the centre point.

placements.name: Canglong Baipu
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Zhejiang Dept of Culture and Tourism (ct.zj.gov.cn) and China Daily Huzhou describe the largest waterfall cluster in northern Zhejiang, a gorge walk with cableway.
placements.skeptic_objection: Only promotional sources; opening hours vary between listings.
placements.bio_draft: nature: "Hidden Dragon Hundred Waterfalls" scenic area in Anji with a cableway and a waterfall gorge
placements.reason: Anji, ~13 km S of the centre point.

placements.name: Anji Yucun
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: China Daily Huzhou government page presents Yucun, a UN Tourism Best Tourism Village, with village walks, bamboo crafts, Future Village hall and Hidden-Dragon Waterfall; open 24 h, a half-day stop.
placements.skeptic_objection: Overlaps in area with Tianhuangping/Jiangnan Tianchi and Anji Bamboo Expo Park; busy weekends.
placements.bio_draft: Rule 1-2: China Daily Huzhou government page presents Yucun, a UN Tourism Best Tourism Village, with village walks, bamboo crafts, Future Village hall and Hidden-Dragon Waterfall; open 24 h, a half-day stop.
placements.reason: Tianhuangping/Yucun area of Anji county; unpinned, pin stage to locate.

placements.name: Yunshang Grassland Starry Sky Ski Resort
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji calls it the closest natural ski resort to Hangzhou and China Daily reported it opening Dec 2025; a permanent ski field (grass skiing in summer).
placements.skeptic_objection: Operator-run, new, 1,168 m with seasonal snow.
placements.wiki: Yunshang Grassland Starry Sky Ski Resort
placements.bio_draft: entertainment: mountain ski resort on a grassland plateau, the closest natural-snow ski resort to Hangzhou (seasonal venue)
placements.reason: ~12 km S of the centre point.

placements.name: Zhejiang Museum of Natural History Anji Branch
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji lists the museum with geology, dinosaur and ecology halls and opening hours.
placements.skeptic_objection: Next to Baicaoyuan and aimed at families; a one-source listing.
placements.wiki: Zhejiang Museum of Natural History Anji Branch
placements.bio_draft: museum: Anji branch of the Zhejiang Museum of Natural History, on the west side of Baicaoyuan, with geology, dinosaur and ecology halls
placements.reason: Baicaoyuan, Dipu, ~12 km N of the centre point.

placements.name: Wu Changshuo Memorial Hall
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: huzhou China Daily pages describe the Anji hall in Changshuo Park with the artist's residence, statue and works; a memorial museum, not a plaque.
placements.skeptic_objection: Wu Changshuo is revered in China but display labels are likely Chinese-only; guide-source evidence is China Daily only.
placements.bio_draft: museum: memorial to the painter and calligrapher Wu Changshuo, who was born in Anji (visitor access not confirmed)
placements.reason: Changshuo Park, Anji county; unpinned, visitor access to be confirmed.

placements.name: Nanxun Ancient Town
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Nanxun listing geotag (scenic area entrance)
placements.bio_draft: town: historic silk-trade water town with bridges, Ming and Qing merchant houses; the old town is free, some houses charge; a 5A scenic area
placements.reason: The old town itself (bridges, canal streets, merchant houses) is the draw and no other spot covers its streets; the town is the destination centre so this spot is the old-quarter street walk. Review whether to rename to "Nanxun Old Town Streets".

placements.name: Jiaye Tang
placements.coordinates_source: OSM way 515355380 (嘉业堂藏书楼), tourism=museum
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun; a famous private library and garden visitors tour inside.
placements.skeptic_objection: Part of Nanxun ancient town's ticketing; keep as it is a distinct gated site.
placements.bio_draft: museum: Jiaye Tang private library (Jiayetang), the largest private library of modern China and an architectural landmark with gardens
placements.reason: ~0.6 km from the town centre.

placements.name: Former Residence of Zhang Shiming
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun; walk-in merchant mansion mixing Chinese courtyards with French stained glass.
placements.skeptic_objection: One of many Nanxun mansions; could be treated as part of the town.
placements.bio_draft: historic: merchant residence blending Chinese courtyards with stained glass and fireplaces in French style
placements.reason: Inside the old town.

placements.name: Little Lotus Garden
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun and Huzhou; 'First Private Garden in Jiangnan', a walk-in garden of an hour.
placements.skeptic_objection: Within the Nanxun scenic area.
placements.bio_draft: park: private garden, "First Private Garden in Jiangnan", in the ancient town
placements.reason: Inside the old town.

placements.name: Mount Mogan
placements.coordinates_source: OSM way 373365921 (莫干山国家重点风景名胜区), leisure=park
placements.bio_draft: nature: mountain and scenic area with a bamboo sea and villas, one of China's four famous summer resorts (zh Wikipedia)
placements.reason: Deqing County scenic mountain with its own Wikivoyage page. About 22 km E of the Anji centre but in a separate county and not part of Anji; Moganshan has only 3 kept spots (Mount Mogan, Villa Cluster, Sword Pool; Lu Hua Dang Park and Tashan are review) so it does not clear the four-spot bar. Standalone. Coordinates: OSM way is the scenic-area centroid, so null here and pin at the village/visitor centre.
placements.pin_note: OSM way is the scenic-area centroid; take a visitor point (village centre or entrance), not the centroid.

placements.name: Moganshan Villa Cluster
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Moganshan; about 150 early 20th-century villas set in bamboo forest.
placements.skeptic_objection: Part of the wider Mount Mogan scenic area, but the villas are a distinct draw visitors walk to.
placements.bio_draft: historic: cluster of about 150 early-20th-century villas built by foreign residents and Republican-era officials, set in bamboo forest
placements.reason: Villas in Moganshan village, inside Mount Mogan scenic area; standalone beside Mount Mogan (a third place, Sword Pool, completes the Moganshan trio, still under four). Pin at the village.

placements.name: Sword Pool Waterfall (Jianchi)
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Moganshan; canyon waterfalls and pools below the village with the sword-casting legend.
placements.skeptic_objection: Ticket is the Moganshan entry ticket; part of the mountain area.
placements.bio_draft: nature: canyon waterfalls and pools below the Moganshan village (the Sword Pool, with the Grindstone rock), entry ticket needed
placements.reason: Canyon below Moganshan village; standalone for the same reason as Mount Mogan.

placements.name: Xiazhu Lake
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: Zhejiang Dept of Culture and Tourism (ct.zj.gov.cn) and China Daily government pages describe a 4A wetland park with crested-ibis base and reed-maze boat trips.
placements.skeptic_objection: Out in Deqing and hours conflict between listings; bird sightings are not guaranteed.
placements.bio_draft: nature: Jiangnan's largest wetland, a release site for crested ibis, in Deqing
placements.reason: Deqing County wetland ~31 km from the Hangzhou centre but in Huzhou prefecture, outside Hangzhou metro bounds; ~20 km from Mount Mogan, not a spot of Anji (~40 km away). Standalone.

placements.name: Xinshi Ancient Town
placements.verdict_reason: Rule 1-2: China Daily Huzhou government pages describe this Deqing water town, promoted to a provincial 5A tourist attraction, with old streets and canals to walk.
placements.skeptic_objection: Another Jiangnan water town beside Nanxun and Wuzhen; crowds and shops.
placements.bio_draft: Rule 1-2: China Daily Huzhou government pages describe this Deqing water town, promoted to a provincial 5A tourist attraction, with old streets and canals to walk.
placements.reason: Deqing water town, outside Hangzhou and Anji bounds; standalone. Unpinned: pin stage.

placements.name: Lake Tai
placements.reason: Already an existing standalone spot (lake-tai); not re-added.

review.name: Huzhou Art Museum
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage listing (daily 09:00-16:30), Greek-style building with calligraphy and relics; a plausible half-hour stop.
review.case_against: Single counted source, no page views; another municipal gallery, only for visitors already in Huzhou city.

review.name: Huzhou Science and Technology Museum
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage listing; open Wed-Sun by online booking, kid-oriented aerospace exhibits.
review.case_against: Local children's science centre, booking in Chinese, not a draw for travellers from elsewhere.

review.name: Zhao Mengfu Former Residence Memorial
review.case_for: Rule 1-3: China Daily Huzhou and huzhou.gov.cn describe a 4,500 sq m memorial hall to the Yuan calligrapher, open since 2012.
review.case_against: Largely reconstructed; overlaps the Zhao Mengfu hall in the Brush Museum and Lianhuazhuang Park, so may be a near-duplicate.

review.name: Xishan Yang Wetland
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage describes it as Huzhou's answer to West Lake with wetland park and painting academy.
review.case_against: One source, thin detail, a local leisure area on the city edge.

review.name: Taihu Lake Tourist Resort
review.case_for: Rule 1-3: Trip.com lists it (Taihu Longemont Paradise, hot springs, water park, circus); a resort district, not one place.
review.case_against: A district bundling several operator venues, overlapping Taihu Tuying and the amusement park; no counted source.

review.name: Taihu Lake Amusement Park
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: a permanent amusement and water park on the Taihu shore (Longemont-type resort), but only travel-site evidence found, no counted source.
review.case_against: Operator-run theme park with no visitor-guide source; may be the same venue as the Taihu Lake Tourist Resort entries.

review.name: Qianshanyang Site
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Neolithic silk-fragment site; no visitor source found and public access unconfirmed.
review.case_against: The finds are in the Zhejiang silk museum; likely a bare field.

review.name: Meishan Section (Permian-Triassic boundary)
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: IUGS geoheritage Permian-Triassic golden spike at Changxing with a museum and geopark; no tourism-board source found.
review.case_against: Of interest mainly to geologists; opening and access unconfirmed.

review.name: Huzhou Taihu Lake Moon Hot Spring Resort
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: a large hot-spring bathing venue (Trip.com's top hot spring in Huzhou, supporting only); visitors can spend hours, but no counted source.
review.case_against: A hotel-linked spa, not a sight; operator-run.

review.name: Former Residence of Zhang Jingjiang
review.case_for: Rule 1-3: Wikivoyage Nanxun lists Zunde Hall as a late-Qing residence open to visitors.
review.case_against: Another Nanxun mansion, near-duplicate of Zhang Shiming's, little to distinguish for a foreign visitor.

review.name: Red House (Liu Ansheng Residence)
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun; Jiangnan facade with a European ballroom interior.
review.case_against: Near-duplicate of the other Nanxun mansions.

review.name: Qiushuli Villa
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun; 1930 East-West villa by the Jiaye Library owner.
review.case_against: Minor villa in the Jiaye precinct; likely part of the Jiaye Tang visit.

review.name: Jili Silk Exhibition Hall
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun; silk exhibition in the former Chamber of Commerce, tied to Nanxun's silk heritage.
review.case_against: Small exhibition hall, possibly the same building as the Silk Guild Hall.

review.name: Baijianlou
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun; riverside Ming houses with sunrise views, also named in the Huzhou district overview.
review.case_against: A row of houses on the town's canal, part of the town itself.

review.name: Guanghui Palace
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Nanxun lists the Taoist temple by Guanghui Bridge.
review.case_against: Small temple, one source, adds little beyond the town walk.

review.name: Digang Ancient Village
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage Huzhou listing for a thousand-year-old village with an original street, few tourists.
review.case_against: Little known and the listing itself calls it quiet; second-tier at best.

review.name: Linghu Ancient Town
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou lists Ming-Qing houses, bridges and canals, open 24 hours.
review.case_against: Quiet and little documented; a second water town beside Nanxun.

review.name: Silver Diggings Under Heaven
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji lists a former silver mine and film-set scenic area with tunnels, 07:00-17:00.
review.case_against: One source; a movie-set theme attraction needing taxi access.

review.name: Dragon King Mountain
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji lists it (CNY 70), a mountain scenic area with no public transport.
review.case_against: Hard to reach and thin detail in the listing.

review.name: Baicaoyuan Garden
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji lists a large man-made garden with mini-zoo and swimming beach (CNY 150).
review.case_against: Family leisure park, high price, mostly amusements.

review.name: Hello Kitty Park
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Anji lists the permanent Hello Kitty theme park with bus access and hours.
review.case_against: Operator-run theme park aimed at children; one source.

review.name: Tashan Forest Park
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou lists it for morning walks near Tashan town on Mount Mogan.
review.case_against: Generic forest park, one source.

review.name: Lu Hua Dang Park
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: reed-marsh park on Moganshan (芦花荡公园); no counted source found in this run's search.
review.case_against: Only a candidate-file mention; may be within the main scenic area.

review.name: Fangfeng Mountain
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou names Fangfeng culture and the mountain in Deqing, but only the temple fair is listed.
review.case_against: The listed draw is an event; nothing confirmed for a regular visit.

review.name: Fangfeng Temple
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: the temple is permanent though Wikivoyage lists only its annual temple fair; same place as Fangfeng Mountain.
review.case_against: The only sourced hook is the fair; near-duplicate of the mountain.

review.name: Xianshan Lake Scenic Area
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou names it among Changxing's attractions; lakeside scenic area at Si'an reservoir.
review.case_against: Thin detail, one source.

review.name: Shuikou Tea Culture Tourism Scenic Area
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage Huzhou names it among Changxing's attractions; a 4A tea-culture area (Trip.com).
review.case_against: Pin is the town centre only; tea tourism of one source.

review.name: Taihu Tuying Resort
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: Trip.com and a Wyndham local-area list name Taihu Tuying Ecology Wetland Culture Park in Changxing; counted source not found.
review.case_against: May duplicate Taihu Lake Tourist Resort; operator-run.

review.name: Taiji Cave
review.case_for: Rule 1: the English Taiji Cave is in Anhui; no Huzhou cave found by search, so the entity is unverified.
review.case_against: The zh Wikipedia link may refer to a real Huzhou cave that I could not confirm.

review.name: Changxing Taihu Museum
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: only travel-platform listings found (free, 7 floors, lake-view top floor, 09:00-16:30), no Wikivoyage/tourism-board page; a real, open museum.
review.case_against: For: free, notable building on the lakeshore, pairs with Taihu Ancient Town. Against: one non-counted source, a standard county museum.

review.name: Yishang Street Historical and Cultural Block
review.case_for: Rule 1: one China Daily Huzhou item (national historic and cultural block with intangible heritage); old-street walk in Huzhou city.
review.case_against: For: named national block. Against: single counted source, short visit, possibly redeveloped shops.

review.name: Anji Ancient City National Archaeological Site Park
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: one China Daily Huzhou item (cherry blossom park at the Anji ancient city site); open site park.
review.case_against: For: public park on an archaeological site. Against: little to see beyond seasonal blossom, one source.

review.name: Taihu Lake Longemont Paradise
review.case_for: Rule 1-2: China Daily Huzhou names it a national nighttime tourism zone with Nanxun; an operator-run theme-park resort.
review.case_against: For: named nighttime culture zone. Against: operator theme park, details thin.

notes: Moganshan (3 kept spots) fails the four-spot bar, so Mount Mogan, Villa Cluster and Sword Pool are standalone.

Standalone within ~40 km of a proposed destination centre: Mount Mogan, Villa Cluster, Sword Pool (~22 km E of Anji; Deqing, outside Anji bounds); Xiazhu Lake (~35 km from Anji, Deqing, outside bounds, ~40 km SE of Huzhou); Xinshi (Deqing, outside bounds). Nanxun/Huzhou 33 km apart, separate towns.
No Jiangnan Water Towns spots: Nanxun is outside its span.
